method: Fit the lower opaque edge of both outer wall wings at alpha 128 using source columns 40–65 and 190–214. Apply one global affine ground correction; vertical uprights remain vertical.
sourceCoordinates: Source X points right and Y points down. Samples use pixel centres at X + 0.5 and the lower opaque edge at Y + 0.5.
rationale: Fit the actual north wall front plane rather than the taller arch silhouette. One bounded affine transform aligns both wings and preserves all source pixels.
